TPOT: (completion time - first streamed content event time) * 1000 / (output event count - 1)
TTFT: (first streamed content event time - HTTP request start time) * 1000
output_count_validation: all completed S2 requests emitted 24 content events and all S3 requests emitted 32, equal to requested max_tokens
output_token_throughput: sum output event counts / whole concurrent trace wall seconds
queue_note: TTFT includes server queue wait after HTTP connection start; TPOT excludes pre-first-token queue time
request_throughput: successful requests / whole concurrent trace wall seconds
